entries.evidence: The hatch behind the engine and its lever group (seats.ldr: the 42003s p249 and p259, the 32140s, the 32054s and the 32316) are loose in the file: each 42003's pin hole lies 2.00 LDU off its pin, the 6558s p165 and p164 of motor.ldr, both off by the same amount (0, -0.10, -2.00), along the holes' line. The booklet has the lever group and the hatch move together on those pins (42040-1-1.pdf pages 48 to 52, 89 and 115; docs/audits/for-erik.md, Model-file findings, medium). Moved by that amount, with its turn as built, both 42003s sit on their pins.
